usedFor: Quire holds tasks and Google Sheets holds your tracker, so “New Task Created” can run “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Quire, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new Quire task gets its own sheet row, so you can sort and total tasks outside Quire.

watchOut: “New Task Created” in Quire is polling, so rows arrive after a scheduled check.
